common_controls.stop_rule: Stop shadow intake on privacy leakage, identity mismatch, duplicate pairing, sequence corruption, recovery failure, alert flood, serious missed event, premature purge or operator interpretation as treatment instruction.

SM-001.evidence_required: clinical governance approval and owner appointment
SM-001.required_state: named owners and governance approval are required
SM-001.stop_condition: Stop if any named owner, governance approval or accountable escalation contact is missing.
SM-001.title: governance activation gate

SM-002.required_state: only approved shadow signal labels are accepted
SM-002.stop_condition: Stop if a signal is phrased as diagnosis, treatment, medication order or clinical certainty.
SM-002.title: non-diagnostic signal vocabulary

SM-003.required_state: tested opaque-token and marker boundary is enforced
SM-003.stop_condition: Stop on raw identity marker, secret/contact leakage or unreviewed upstream/export/log/backup boundary.
SM-003.title: Zero-PII input boundary

SM-004.required_state: reviewer, reason and ordered timestamps are required
SM-004.stop_condition: Stop if reviewer, reason, classification or event/received/review time ordering is incomplete.
SM-004.title: review classification workflow

SM-005.evidence_required: approved analysis plan and complete review dataset
SM-005.required_state: coverage and denominators accompany workflow/data-quality rates
SM-005.stop_condition: Stop if review coverage, unreviewed count or denominator semantics are absent or accuracy is inferred.
SM-005.title: non-accuracy metric semantics

SM-006.evidence_required: clinical escalation and manual fallback drill
SM-006.required_state: incident stop blocks intake until separate approval
SM-006.stop_condition: Stop on privacy, identity, duplicate pairing, sequence, recovery, alert flood, serious missed event or operator misuse incident.
SM-006.title: stop/resume safety control

SM-007.required_state: workflow-changing notifications and threshold changes require separate approval
SM-007.stop_condition: Stop if notification, threshold, risk-weight, deduplication or policy change bypasses approval and rollback control.
SM-007.title: change and notification boundary
